meta_description: Terracotta jali facade tiles in a square-grid pattern for building fronts, stair walls and screens that let air and light in. Free WhatsApp sample.
description:
Terracotta Jali Tiles 001 are a square-grid design for a terracotta jali facade, the perforated clay screen shown in the product photo covering the front of a building, letting air and filtered light pass through while softening sun and street views.

## How it looks
The photo shows a clean square grid repeated across a whole elevation. A square grid jali reads as modern and orderly, and the warm terracotta colour tends to sit well with brick, plaster and concrete. Up close the openings cast a pattern of light and shadow that changes through the day.

## Where it works
- **Jali screen for building front** elevations, as a second skin in front of windows or balconies.
- **Stair walls and service shafts**, where ventilation matters and full glazing is not needed.
- **Boundary and terrace screens** for privacy with airflow.

Jali has long been used in South Asian buildings to cut glare and keep air moving, and clay tends to weather to a natural patina rather than peeling like paint.

## Good to know
- Category: terracotta jali
- Pattern: square grid (from a building facade photo)
- Size and thickness are not listed online yet; confirm them before you plan the frame and quantities.

A large clay jali facade design usually needs a supporting frame or proper bonding into the structure, so involve your architect or contractor in the fixing detail. Clean with water and a soft brush.

## See it before you order
Visit the Lahore head office on Walton Road (opposite Packages Mall Gate 2) or G-04 Civic Center, Executive Block, Gulberg Greens, Islamabad, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm. Ask for a [free sample on WhatsApp](https://wa.me/923004617715) and send your wall size and city for a dated quote. Read the [terracotta jali guide](/blog/terracotta-jali-in-pakistan-designs-uses-and-ordering-guide) or browse the full [terracotta jali range](/categories/terracotta-jali).

faqs.q: What is the price of terracotta jali for a facade?
faqs.a: Pak Clay does not publish a fixed rate online. The price depends on the design, the wall area and delivery, so send your measurements and city on WhatsApp (+92 300 4617715) for a dated written quote.

faqs.q: Is terracotta jali good for a building front?
faqs.a: It is a common choice. A jali screen cuts direct sun and glare, keeps air moving and adds privacy, and clay tends to weather naturally. Large facades need a proper support or bonding detail from your architect or contractor.

faqs.q: Terracotta jali or cement jali: which is better?
faqs.a: Terracotta gives a warm natural colour and a traditional feel; cement jali is grey, can be painted and suits industrial looks. The choice usually comes down to the look you want and how the screen will be fixed.

faqs.q: How do I get a sample?
faqs.a: Message Pak Clay on WhatsApp at +92 300 4617715 with the product name and your city, or visit the Lahore showroom on Walton Road or the Islamabad location at G-04 Civic Center, Gulberg Greens, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm.
